title: poa suksdorfii
intro: Poa suksdorfii, commonly known as Suksdorf's bluegrass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This perennial grass has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, digestive issues, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Poa suksdorfii are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
